Automatic correction can be wrong and doesn't replace reciting to a qualified teacher.

map.يُستخدم الميكروفون فقط أثناء التسميع وأن: The microphone is used only during Tasmee while you press the record button. In the Android app recognition happens on the phone itself, so your voice never leaves it. On the web, recognition uses the browser's own service: Google in Chrome and Apple in Safari. We don't save or send recordings of your voice.

The microphone is used only during Tasmee while you press the record button, to recognise your recitation and compare it with the Mushaf. In the Android app recognition happens on your phone with a model built into the app, so your voice never leaves the phone. On the web, recognition uses the browser's service (Google in Chrome, Apple in Safari). The app doesn't save or send recordings of your voice.
map.يُستخدم موقعك لحساب مواقيت الصلاة واتجاه: Your location is used to work out prayer times and the Qibla, and the calculation happens on your device. Only to know your city's name, approximate coordinates are sent to BigDataCloud; they aren't stored by us or linked to you.

Your location is used to work out prayer times and the Qibla, and the calculation itself happens on your phone. Only to know your city's name, approximate coordinates are sent to your phone system's geocoding service, or to BigDataCloud if that isn't available; they aren't stored by us or linked to you.
